idea-plugin.name: Editor Tab Grouping
idea-plugin.description:
Groups the editor tabs by directory to bring order to a crowded tab row.

Features

  • Keeps the tabs of files from the same directory together. Each group has a color, so you can find it at a glance.
  • Collects the agent tabs in a separate Agents group, so they do not mix with your files.

Getting started

The grouping is on by default. Configure in Settings | Editor | General | Editor Tabs
